        - ['<h2 id="toc-title">Contents from the organisation extension</h2>']

## Section

The `orgfile` extension is in an organisation directory, `_extensions/acme/orgfile/`.
Before the fix, Quarto looked for the language file in `_extensions/acme/_extensions/acme/orgfile/`.
The table of contents must show the title from the language file of the extension.
